summary.title: Effect of Metformin on Breast Cancer metabolism (NCT01266486)
summary.abstract: A clinical pharmacodynamic window study investigating the transcriptomic and metabolic effects of metformin on 41 women with untreated primary breast cancer[cite: 3]. The dataset includes paired pre- and post-treatment RNASeq transcriptomic profiling, broad metabolomics, and 18-FDG PET-CT imaging to assess metabolic reprogramming[cite: 3].

documentation.description:
The METFORMIN trial (NCT01266486) is a clinical pharmacodynamic window study evaluating the metabolic effects of metformin on 41 women with untreated, in situ primary breast cancer[cite: 3]. The dataset provides comprehensive pre- and post-treatment profiling, integrating RNASeq transcriptomics, broad metabolomics, and 18-FDG PET-CT imaging to explore mitochondrial metabolic reprogramming and nutrient utilization limits[cite: 3].

### Study Design & Recruitment
*   **Setting:** Patients were recruited from breast cancer clinics across three UK centres: Oxford, Luton, and Dundee[cite: 3].
*   **Timeline:** Recruitment occurred over a 30-month period between May 2011 and November 2013[cite: 3].
*   **Intervention:** Metformin (Glucophage XR) was administered once daily in escalating doses for a minimum of 13 days and a maximum of 21 days (500mg for days 1–3, 1000mg for days 4–6, and 1500mg thereafter)[cite: 3].
*   **Biopsy Protocol:** Core biopsies were taken under ultrasound guidance from the periphery of the primary tumour the day before commencing metformin, snap-frozen in liquid nitrogen within 1 minute, and stored at -80°C[cite: 3].

### Patient & Tumour Characteristics
*   **Demographics:** The median age at study entry was 49 years (range 27–67), with a median body mass index of 28.1 (range 19.6–45.3)[cite: 3].
*   **ER/HER2 Status:** The cohort included 32 ER positive, 9 ER negative, 8 HER2 positive, 33 HER2 negative, and 8 triple negative patients[cite: 3].
*   **Tumour Details:** Tumour types consisted of 32 ductal carcinomas, 7 lobular carcinomas, and 1 mixed[cite: 3].
*   **Tumour Grade & Size:** Tumours were classified as Grade 1 (2 patients), Grade 2 (24 patients), and Grade 3 (15 patients), with a median tumour size on MRI of 49mm[cite: 3].

### Sample Availability & Data Types
*   **PET-CT Scans:** 36 paired 18-FDG PET-CT scans are available for analysis[cite: 3].
*   **Metabolomics:** 29 paired tumour samples provided sufficient material for broad metabolomics analysis and lipid profiling[cite: 3].
*   **RNASeq:** 36 paired tumour samples underwent Next-generation sequencing of 'Poly (A) targeted' mRNA, with the fold change of normalised expression level estimated using Cuffdiff 2.2.1[cite: 3].
*   **Immunohistochemistry:** Staining for p-AMPK and pAKT was evaluated by two accredited pathologists to generate an H-score of immunoreactivity based on intensity and percentage of positive cells[cite: 3].

### Eligibility Criteria
*   **Inclusion:** Women >18 years with histology-proven in situ primary breast cancer ≥2 cm, scheduled to commence neoadjuvant chemotherapy in 3 weeks, possessing an ECOG performance status of 0–1, and fasting/random serum glucose less than 7.0 mmol/L[cite: 3].
*   **Exclusion:** Patients with a history of Type 1 or Type 2 diabetes, metformin treatment in the past year, or prior treatment for breast cancer (including radiotherapy, major surgery, or chemotherapy within four weeks) were excluded[cite: 3].

### Data Quality Control
*   Data quality was verified using Rosner's generalized extreme Studentized deviate test alongside graphical presentations[cite: 3].
